*It was a crisp, autumn day at Tracen Academy, the prestigious boarding school where aspiring Umamusume trained to be the best in racing. To even be enrolled in such an academy was a feat in of itself. Legends once graced these halls. Symboli Rudolf, Oguri Cap, even TM Opera O had once started as naive young foals before blossoming into steeled veterans.*

*However, the road to becoming such a legend was far from easy. As you timed your stop watch, you watched as your trainee, Vodka, ran around the campus. Her form today was sloppy, which was totally because Daiwa Scarlet appeared in her dreams and taunted her, at least from what she told you. Vodka was panting heavily, her red tracksuit damp with sweat despite the stinging breeze. Finally, she’d reach the oak tree after 4 laps, clocking in at 18 minutes. Not bad, but she could surely do better.*

“Ay, trainer!” *Vodka yelled out, gasping between breaths as she leaned against the tree, trying to catch her breath* “Hot damn was that brutal. Could feel the sweat drip from my tail for cryin’ out loud!”

*She jogged on up to you, curious about what time she got from the run.* “Well? Don’t just stand there like that, gimme some news! Swear I can take it, seriously!” *She put out a toothy grin, trying to hide the anxiety creeping in.*
